name: Locthwain
description: Kingdom ruled by Ayara, compleated by the Phyrexians.

description_citations.text: "Rankle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Locthwain falls to the invaders while the realm's great minds quarrel over a strange eclipse.

citation.text: Phyrexian Unlife (Wilds of Eldraine: Enchanting Tales, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ayara stays as ruler of Locthwain rather than withdrawing with her kin into the Wilds.
timeline.quote: Ayara remained as the ruler of Locthwain rather than withdraw with her brethren into the Wilds

citation.text: "Ayara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ayara and the court of Locthwain are compleated in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Ayara, along with the rest of the court of Locthwain, was compleated as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Ayara", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mankind overthrows the Elven Lords who enslaved them; the five knightly courts are created and Locthwain is established around the Cauldron of Eternity.
timeline.quote: mankind rose and overthrew the Elven Lords that had enslaved them, and the five knightly courts were created

citation.text: "Locthwain", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ayara and most of the court of Locthwain are compleated and the castle becomes a Phyrexian fortress.
timeline.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Ayara and most of the court of Locthwain were compleated .

citation.text: "Locthwain", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rankle's love spell enchants the court and many fall to their deaths from the castle.
timeline.quote: many fell to their deaths from the castle

citation.text: "Locthwain", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Locthwain, Rankle finds Ayara compleated and steals Torbran's ring of three wishes.
timeline.quote: Unfazed, he stole Torbran's ring of three wishes

citation.text: "Rankle", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rankle's third wish rains love potion; the Phyrexians pursue him and fall into the chasm as the Wicked Slumber overtakes them.
timeline.quote: all the Phyrexians, affected by the love potion, pursued Rankle and fell into the chasm, just as the Wicked Slumber overtook them

citation.text: "Rankle", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
